formattedAddress: 116, Taiwan, Taipei City, Wenshan District, Xingde Village, Alley 4, Lane 112, Section 3, Xinglong Rd, 46號1樓

text.text:
2025/10/25 - Pay by cash only.
Very student-friendly restaurant. We saw lots of student eat here.
The water, utensil, tissue, and plastic gloves are all self-service, so you have to get them yourself.
The fried food was fantastic.
The buttermilk fried chicken was juicy and tender inside, and crispy outside. And the French fries were freshly baked I believe, which is why they tasted the best out of the the other food on the fried platter. The chicken tender was okay as well.
The best sauces to pair with all the fried food were the honey mustard and barbecue sauce.

text.text: Nice place, great vibe with decent food. The meat is unseasoned making the burgers bland and a little dry. The mozzarella sticks are practically empty, which was unfortunate, but there is plenty of other food on the menu to try.

text.text: Had the Double Spicy Chicken sandwich and my wife had the Cowboy burger. Overall, the chicken sandwich was very juicy and the sauce was really good without be overly spicy. The sandwich fell apart after a while, but you cant blame the chef on that whens theres that much chicken and sauce. For the cowboy burger, it is said it could use a bit more seasoning, but overall very good. Will come again to try the other options.
